name: Raising the Standard of Tiatr
benefit:
- Reimbursement of the value of ticket(s) for witnessing high-standard dramas.
- To cover the cost incurred by artists for purchasing tickets to watch high-standard plays, thereby encouraging them to improve their performance quality.

_*The value of the ticket(s) will be reimbursed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa after a brief report about the drama seen and the counter-foils of tickets are submitted
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a director, script writer, artist, or backstage artist. - The applicant must submit a self-attested copy of their Aadhaar Card along with the application.
